content: This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current medical condition. It is important to dispose of any unused medication after completing the treatment or after 14 days, whichever comes first. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store the unopened bottle in the refrigerator. Once opened, the medication can be stored either in the refrigerator or at room temperature. However, once the bottle is opened, the medication expires after 14 days. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. In the event of an overdose, this medication may be harmful if swallowed. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less severe cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this medication and your individual health needs.
